description: Defines Chromium command-line switches and feature toggles for Playwright, including functions to generate switch lists based on parameters like assistant mode, channel, and Android support.

methods.name: disabledFeatures
methods.description: Returns an array of feature flags to disable in Chromium based on assistant mode.

methods.name: chromiumSwitches
